reasons: Missing-clause finding is well supported: the provided paragraphs contain no insurance covenant and the only 'insurance' reference cited is a fees/taxes shipping allocation, so an insert is the correct operation.

Inserted subsection (l) tracks the playbook model language and correct direction (obligation on Licensor, the counterparty): CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M for processing of Licensee data, workers' comp as required by law, certificates on request, term plus one year.
Placement and lettering are appropriate — appended at the end of General Provisions immediately after existing subsection (k), with the original text of p0159 left unchanged (no collateral edits).
Comment is accurate, concise, in the required first-person-plural tone with the [Playbook] prefix, states what changed and why, cites the preferred position and offers the E&O 1M / cyber 2M fallback.
Deterministic checks pass and the changed-character ratio is inherent to inserting a new clause, which the rule requires.
